scripts.text: Almost forgot the most important thing.
Hats that I can replicate are:
^0571B0Frog Hat, Romantic Flower, Magestic Goat, Blush, Valkyrie Helm, Deviruchi Hat, Assassin Mask, Elven Ears, Hahoe Mask, and Boys Cap^000000 a total of 10 types.
scripts.translation: 0571B0青蛙帽、花叶、山羊头盔、腮红、瓦尔基里头盔、小恶魔帽、刺客口罩、妖精长耳朵饰、传统面具和男孩帽，总共10种。 ^0571B0^000000

scripts.text: What do you think? I'll make it happen as long as I have the ingredients and the compensation.
scripts.translation: 你觉得怎么样？只要有材料和报酬，我就能做到。

scripts.text: What? Are you kidding me? Please tell me you are!
scripts.translation: 什么？你在开玩笑吧？求求你告诉我你在开玩笑！

scripts.text: You made the right call. I thought I was going to starve to death because the Laphines have no interest in pretty hats.
scripts.translation: ，你可选对人了。拉菲尼对漂亮帽子没兴趣，我还以为自己要饿死了。

scripts.text: I'll make it a great deal for you. You really should know I'm giving you a good deal here.
scripts.translation: 我会给你一个超划算的价格。你应该知道我在给你优惠。

scripts.text: Is there something you had in mind? Why don't you take a look?
scripts.translation: 你有什么想法吗？不如看看这个？

scripts.text: Ay... Credit purchases are difficult for me.
scripts.translation: 唉...赊账对我来说有点难办。

scripts.text: ^E1281E50 Splendide Coins, 4 Crystal Mirrors, 1 Fairy Magic Powder, 10 of each Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire, Topaz, and Zircon^000000 are necessary.
scripts.translation: 0}，以及50枚辉煌领域金币、4面水晶镜子、1份妖精魔法粉，翡翠、红宝石、蓝宝石、黄玉和锆石各10颗。 ^E1281E^000000

scripts.text: I'm in a tight spot myself. Please consider my situation also.
scripts.translation: 我自己手头也很紧。请体谅一下我的处境。

scripts.text: Yes, this is more than enough. Should I make it now?
scripts.translation: 好的，这些足够了。我现在就开始制作吗？

scripts.text: Oops, I have to take care of something...
Hey.. Hey! Hey! Where you going?
I got it. Oh right! Almost forgot again.
scripts.translation: 明白了。对了！差点又忘了。

scripts.text: ^FF0000In the process of replication, magic intervention phenomenon causes the hat to lose all of its refinements, cards, and hidden enchantments.^000000
scripts.translation: 在复制过程中，魔法干涉现象会导致帽子失去所有的精炼等级、卡片和隐藏附魔。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000And if you possess multiple hats of the same type, the one you don't want can undergo the replication process, so please check to make sure.^000000
scripts.translation: 如果身上有多顶同款帽子，就可能用到您不想拿来复制的那顶，请务必先确认。 ^FF0000^000000
那么，您对此有什么异议吗？

scripts.text: It's finally time for me to use my skills again.
scripts.translation: 了。终于轮到我大显身手了。

scripts.text: Do this thing here, and do that thing there, and then do this thing here again...
scripts.translation: 这里弄一下，那里弄一下，然后再弄一下这里...

scripts.text: Good. This is a satisfying result.
scripts.translation: 很好。这是一个令人满意的

scripts.text: I'll do even a better job next time. Please tell others about my work. Have a good day~
scripts.translation: 结果。下次我会做得更好。请把我的手艺推荐给其他人吧。祝您愉快~
